task.name_zh: 四套件多任务轨迹偏移诊断
task.hypothesis: 检验量化是否改变平移分散度、旋转有向漂移，以及是否存在跨初态重复的可补偿窗口；允许无拐点。
task.changed_variable: 首轮固定多suite OFT检查点、输入、8动作执行与配对初态，仅改变权重量化档；不训练。

methods.notes: Native backend only W2/W4/W8 A16; W3 and AWQ+A QDQ need separate adapters/identities.
W4/W8/W16 with A4/A8/A16; full closed loop forbidden until C0 passes.
Useful W3/W2 comparator; no arbitrary registry rename.
Separate clipping/reconstruction optimization cost from inference.
LEARNED equivalent transformation needs frozen/reload and FP equivalence controls.
Not the same name/method as QVLA.
Pin exact paper/repository/version before integration; no compatibility claim.

offline_selection: 2 predeclared query states per task across all 40 tasks, no success-only filter; paired BF16 reference; distinct calibration role.
confirmation: At most 2 predeclared surviving candidates + BF16, resets6/7, at most240 additional episodes; no automatic full method-bitwidth grid.
backup: Only incremental code/config/aggregate/clearly synthetic figures public. Source PPT and measured raw data stay private.
question_v2: 分离权重与激活量化、重参数化及误差耦合，检查四suite多任务中的轨迹偏离、动作块尾部和阶段错拍；允许无拐点。
